title: OMT action-parity matrix (v1)
description: Classification of every protocol action (R22): agent_available actions expose identical qualified context on every consumer (DSH adapter, CLI, Tauri, MCP); adapter_only actions belong to one adapter channel; human_administrative actions are reserved for humans via CLI/desktop and audited when delegated. The entries array is the seed for the extracted v1 vocabulary; later units extend it additively.

ActionName.description: Protocol method name this classification applies to.

since.description: Protocol version that introduced the action.

ActionParityMatrix.description: The full published matrix. revision increases whenever the matrix changes; consumers should treat unknown actions as NOT agent_available.

SeedActionParityMatrix.$comment: Seed classification of the U1 command vocabulary. node/execute and ui/* are the DSH-adapter channels; home/reindex is human maintenance (CLI/desktop). Everything else is agent-available everywhere.
